{{TAG:0005:0000:}} ist!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Wir begegnen uns

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}I see!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Why not join me for a spell

{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Davvero?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Perbacco! Allora devi

EN:
Even though I've stepped down as
mayor,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} this is my beloved home.
I've lived here a good many years.
That's why every so often I come
by to see how things are going and
get myself a cup of coffee.
...Well, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}I have to say the bigger
reason of the two{{TAG:0003:0023:}} is to come get
the coffee. It's so refreshing!
ES:
Aunque ya estoy retirado como
alcalde,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} guardo buenos recuerdos
de este pueblo y mis años aquí.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Por eso suelo pasarme de vez
en cuando{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} a ver cómo va todo
y tomarme una taza de café.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Aunque...{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} la principal razón para
venir{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}} es el café. ¡Me encanta!
FR:
Même si je ne suis plus le maire,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
j'ai encore plein de souvenirs des
moments passés à {{TAG:0005:0005:}}.
C'est pourquoi je viens parfois voir
comment tout le monde se porte
tout en profitant d'un bon café.
Mais... {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}je t'avoue que la raison de
mes visites reste surtout{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}} le café !
IT:
Vedi, giovincell{{TAG:000E:0006:02006F0002006100}}... Anche se adesso
non sono più il sindaco,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} in questa
città mi sento ancora a casa.
È per questo che ogni tanto passo
di qui per sentire le ultime notizie...
e per gustarmi un ottimo caffè!
... Anzi, sarò onesto: {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}il motivo
principale{{TAG:0003:0023:}} è proprio il caffè. Quello
che servono qui non ha paragoni!
DE:
Ich habe das Bürgermeisteramt an
den Nagel gehängt,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} aber ich liebe
meine alte Stadt wie eh und je.
Ich komme immer mal wieder vor-
bei, um nach dem Rechten zu schau-
en und mir einen Kaffee zu gönnen.
Ich muss sagen,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}} der Kaffee ist fast
der wichtigere Grund von beiden.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0002:}}He he huff!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0003:0023:}}

Başkanlığı bırakmış olsam da{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}

yıllar burada yaşadım.
O yüzden ara sıra kasabada işler
nasıl gidiyor diye bakmaya ve
bir fincan kahve içmeye geliyorum.
...Gerçi{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} ikincisi için gelmemin
sebebi biraz daha büyük{{TAG:0003:0023:}}. Kahve
insanı kendine getiriyor!

EN:
{{TAG:000E:0004:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} sure has changed a lot {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}

el pueblo ha cambiado bastante.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Sin duda{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} se nota la mano{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} de la
nueva persona al cargo.{{TAG:0007:0000:28000000}} Sabes lo
que quiero decir, ¿no, granujilla?
FR:
Depuis que je suis parti à la
retraite,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} la ville a déjà tellement
changé !
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}C'est l'intérêt d'avoir un nouveau
maire. Un peu de changement ne

DE:
Seit ich {{TAG:0005:0005:}} nicht mehr

{{TAG:000E:0004:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} kasabası başkanlığı

değişti{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ama yeni başkanın amacı
da biraz budur sanırım.

değildir, filiz!

Chasser la fatigue due au printemps

un po' sonnacchioso. Non mi
resta altra scelta che bere caffè{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}

Die Frühjahrsmüdigkeit mit einem
starken Kaffee wegblasen{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Das
kann man nur im Frühling erleben!

İyi yapılmış sert bir kahveyle

Par exemple, il fait très chaud en ce

... manger de la soupe devant un
ventilateur à pleine puissance.

Rien ne réchauffe plus mon cœur

Tu te demandes pourquoi je viens

Eh bien, tu vois, c'est comme{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.
... quand tu t'enveloppes dans une

Non chiedermi perché abbia deciso

Deshalb bin ich dieses Mal im

Böyle soğuk bir kış gününde

sıcacık battaniyelere sarılıp

Since I want as many people as
possible to come play on the island,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
I've been talking to people in town.
But everyone says they're so busy
with work, they can't come!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:000C:0001:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Say, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Brewster{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} You should rest
those wings of yours on my island
from time to time! It'd be good!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}

Siempre invito a la gente del
pueblo a venir a mi isla{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} porque
me encantan las visitas.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Pero todo el mundo está siempre
muy ocupado con su trabajo, así
que no me hacen caso.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:000C:0001:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¡Dime,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} {{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Fígaro{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} ¿No te apetecería

Au fait, je me sens un peu seul sur
mon île,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} alors j'ai invité tous les
habitants de la ville !
Mais ils me répondent tous qu'ils
sont trop occupés par leur travail.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:000C:0001:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Hé, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Robusto {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Tu m'as l'air un peu
fatigué. Et si tu venais te remplumer
sur mon île ?{{TAG:000C:0009:}}

Sto facendo il giro della città
per convincere più abitanti possibile
a venire a visitare l'isola dove abito.{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}
Purtroppo, però, sembra che tutti
quanti siano troppo occupati
a lavorare! Che disdetta!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:000C:0001:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Di' un po', {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Bartolo{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Non hai voglia
di volartene per un po' sulla mia
isola? Ti farebbe bene, sai?!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}
DE:
Wir wollen mehr Besucher auf die
Insel locken, deshalb putze ich hier
in {{TAG:0005:0005:}} fleißig Klinken.
Aber alle sagen, sie seien zu
beschäftigt!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:000C:0001:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Was ist mit dir, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Kofi{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}?{{TAG:0007:0000:1E000000}} Du könntest
sicher auch etwas Erholung auf
meiner Insel vertragen!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}

Adaya mümkün olduğunca çok kişi
gelsin istiyorum,{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} bu yüzden
kasabadakilerle konuşup duruyorum.
Ama herkes işi başından aşkın
olduğu için gelemeyeceğini
söylüyor!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:000C:0001:}}{{TAG:000C:0007:}}{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}Hey, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}{{TAG:0000:0003:0400}}Brewster{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0001:}} Arada
kanatlarını dinlendirmek için
adama gel! İyi gelir!{{TAG:000C:0009:}}

EN:
{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} has finally gotten
a little warmer!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}But if you want to get a taste of
summer's heat a bit early, sprout{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}come to my island at any time!

¡En {{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} por fin van

de calor antes del verano{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}¡ven a mi isla, granujilla!

La temperatura {{TAG:000E:0010:}} {{TAG:0005:0005:}} si è
ingentilita un po', finalmente!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ma se sei troppo impaziente e
vuoi subito l'estate{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0003:0023:}} Vieni
a trovarmi sulla mia isola!
DE:
Hier in {{TAG:0005:0005:}} wird's endlich
wieder etwas wärmer,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} was?{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Wenn du keine Lust mehr hast,
länger auf den Sommer zu warten{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}komm einfach auf meine Insel!

{{TAG:000E:0003:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}} sonunda biraz ısındı!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Ama yaz
sıcağının tadına biraz erken
bakmak istersen, filiz{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0003:0023:}}istediğin zaman adama gel!

go to the island when it's summer,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}
but that's a huge misunderstanding!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}There are a bunch of critters,
plants, and fruit you can only see
on the island! It's true, sprout!

Quizá pienses que no vale la pena
ir a una isla en pleno verano{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}}
¡pero te equivocas por completo!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Hay montones de plantas, frutas
y animales allí{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} que no encontrarás
nunca en este pueblo, granujilla!
FR:
Si tu crois qu'il ne sert à rien de
visiter mon île en plein été,{{TAG:0007:0000:05000000}} tu te
trompes !
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tortiland regorge d'animaux, de
plantes et de fruits qu'on ne voit
pas ici !
IT:
